Project Studies

We gladly supervise project studies for students enrolled at TUM School of Management.

Please note: We are lawyers, so the topic of the project studies should include some legal aspects. If not, then we need to decide on a case-by-case basis if we are able to act as supervisors. As a rule of thumb: the closer the topic is to our key areas of research (in particular, finance and capital markets regulation), the better. We are particularly interest in the area of fintech.

Some examples of past project studies under our supervision:

  • Two-tier Board Structure and Conflict of Interests - A Legal and Empirical Analysis of the Composition of the Boards of Common Law Companies in Common Law Countries
  • Legal and Strategic Aspects of a Cryptocurrency Hedge Fund
  • Floating Ether and Marketing Analysis of a Blockchain Investment Fund
  • Introduction To Ethereum: Use Cases And Limitations
  • Sustainable Finance EU Taxonomy
  • Hyper Personalization for Digital Banks
  • Patenting of Software Solutions

If you are interested, or if there are any queries, please contact us under office.law@wi.tum.de
